instruction: Boot the candidate Gaming ISO (HORNEROS_INSTALLER_CANDIDATE_GAMING=1) in a disposable VM (UEFI firmware, blank target disk), launch the graphical installer, choose the Gaming "Desktop Gaming" specialization when prompted, create the QA user, let installation finish, reboot with the ISO detached, authenticate at the greeter, and leave the installed desktop running for the proofs. Steam is an explicit application opt-in and must not be installed by the group selection.
